name: Shams Al Salama Opticals (Approved RTA Eye Test Center)

owner_description: Shams Al Salama Opticals provide best products/brands at best prices with fast shipping and customer care.we accepted all insurance

reviews.author: Vijetha Kulal
reviews.text:
Choosing the right pair of glasses can take some time, and I really appreciated how patiently the team at Shams Al Salama Opticals helped me through the entire selection process.

They understood all the requirements I had and guided me patiently in choosing the right frame and lenses. I’m very happy with the final product—it was exactly the way I wanted it.

Really appreciate their attention to detail, patience, and excellent customer service. Highly recommended! 😊

reviews.author: Triveni
reviews.text: Great collection and excellent service! Mufeeda and Anagha were extremely helpful, friendly, and patient in helping me choose the right pair. Really appreciated their warm and professional service. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Jovelyn Doldol
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience at Al Salama Opticals. The staff was knowledgeable and helpful throughout the entire process, from eye testing to selecting the right lenses and frames. The eye examination was thorough, and the optometrist took time to explain everything clearly. They also offer a great collection of frames with reasonable pricing. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality eye care and eyewear!

reviews.author: Mario Melvin Yaco
reviews.text:
I had a really pleasant experience at this optical shop and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for quality eyewear and excellent service. They offer a wide range of eyeglasses, from stylish modern frames to more classic designs, so it’s easy to find something that suits both your taste and budget.

The shop itself is clean, well-organized, and comfortable, which made browsing and trying on frames a stress-free experience. What stood out the most, though, was the staff. They were friendly, patient, and genuinely helpful—taking the time to understand my needs without being pushy. Their professionalism and knowledge made me feel confident in my choices.

Overall, it’s a great place if you’re looking for good options, a welcoming environment, and attentive service. I’ll definitely be coming back in the future. Kudos!

reviews.author: BENITA
reviews.text: The staff were very helpful, patient, and guided me well in choosing the right frame and lenses. The service was smooth, professional, and the overall atmosphere was welcoming. Really happy with the quality and customer care. Highly recommended!
